name: chrisesser/keel
description: A zero-dependency PHP 8.4 application framework with users, organizations, auth and billing already built.

suggest.stripe/stripe-php: Required only for Keel\Billing — subscriptions, payment methods and webhooks (^20.3)
suggest.ext-sodium: Required only for Keel\Security\Crypto — encrypting secrets at rest, e.g. TOTP seeds
suggest.ext-curl: Required only for the Mailgun and Twilio providers
